name: Nginx Proxy Manager
tagline: Reverse proxy with free Let's Encrypt certificates, managed from a web page.
description: Nginx Proxy Manager gives each of your apps its own address (photos.example.com) with HTTPS, and requests the Let's Encrypt certificates itself, from a simple web interface.
postInstall: Open the Admin port and create the administrator account.
Forward ports 80 and 443 of your router to this server for Let's Encrypt and outside access.
Ports 80 and 443 can be taken by HSI's own HTTPS on standard ports: then turn that off, or pick other ports here.
